## Discrete: from a PMF

```{r}
x <- c(0, 1, 2, 5); p <- c(.4, .3, .2, .1)
EX  <- sum(x * p)            # E[X]
EX2 <- sum(x^2 * p)          # E[X^2] by LOTUS
c(mean = EX, var = EX2 - EX^2, sd = sqrt(EX2 - EX^2))
sum(exp(x) * p); exp(EX)     # E[g(X)] is not g(E[X])
```

## Continuous: integrate

```{r}
f <- function(x) 3 * x^2     # density on [0, 1]
EX  <- integrate(function(x) x * f(x), 0, 1)$value
EX2 <- integrate(function(x) x^2 * f(x), 0, 1)$value
c(mean = EX, var = EX2 - EX^2)        # 0.75 and 3/80
integrate(function(x) f(x) / x, 0, 1)$value   # E[1/X] = 1.5, not 1/0.75
```

## Long-run average (as in Lab 2)

```{r}
set.seed(12)
rolls <- sample(6, 1e5, replace = TRUE)
running <- cumsum(rolls) / seq_along(rolls)
running[c(10, 100, 1000, 1e5)]        # approaches 3.5
```

## Named distributions: simulation check

```{r}
set.seed(12)
n <- 1e5
sims <- list(
  binom = rbinom(n, 40, 0.15),     # theory: mean 6,  var 5.1
  geom  = rgeom(n, 0.2) + 1,       # rgeom counts failures; +1 gives trials: mean 5, var 20
  pois  = rpois(n, 3.5),           # mean 3.5, var 3.5
  exp   = rexp(n, rate = 0.25),    # mean 4, var 16
  gamma = rgamma(n, shape = 3, rate = 0.5)  # mean 6, var 12
)
sapply(sims, function(s) c(mean = mean(s), var = var(s)))
```
